description: A built-in that V8 runs to its end without an interrupt check, asked for more elements than the heap holds (2^27 numbers under a 64 MiB heap): the call ends at once, as the heap limit ends it, and the host aborts the run. It used to run 18 s and take 1.9 GiB.

abort.message: the script used more than 64 MiB of heap
